fighterA.name: Superman

dossier.style: Direct combat based on powerful physical strength, speed bursts, and heavy strikes.
dossier.advantage: Monstrous advantage in strength, speed, and durability statistics over most opponents.
dossier.mentality: Usually holds back and only escalates when the stakes or threat to people force it.
dossier.quote: This looks like a job for Superman.

powers: Kryptonian strength, speed, flight, and enhanced sensory perception.
tools: Solar Flare as a high-cost finishing option.
weaknesses: Kryptonite exposure, magic susceptibility, and red-sun power loss.
Solar Flare leaves a temporary vulnerability window if it does not end the fight.

crucialFeats: Bench-presses a weight equal to Earth's mass for five days.
Reads every published medical text in seconds.
Flies out of a black hole without taking damage.
The only person who endured Doomsday's death aura.

fighterB.name: King Hyperion

dossier.style: Brutal close-quarters aggression. Hyperion fights like a god of war, using Atomic Vision and unimaginable strength to physically destroy and humiliate opponents.
dossier.advantage: Inhuman regeneration and survivability. Returns to the fight even after decapitation or being torn to shreds.
dossier.mentality: Megalomaniac psychopath with a god complex. Murdered the heroes of his world not out of necessity, but for pleasure and power. Knows no mercy or hesitation.

powers: Extreme strength, durability, flight, and rapid regeneration.
tools: Experienced in killing heroes. Knows well their weaknesses and psychology.
weaknesses: Argonite vulnerability and psychological instability in some portrayals.
Extreme arrogance can open tactical gaps against disciplined opponents.

crucialFeats: Comes back to life moments after Namora twists his neck one hundred and eighty degrees.
Kills Vision with a single hit from his Atomic Vision.

tactical-board.headline: TACTICAL BOARD // SUPERMAN VS KING HYPERION
tactical-board.subtitle: Hero versus Tyrant
tactical-board.lane: Superman wins by closing it out. Hyperion wins when the closeout fails.

final-summary.headline: FINAL SUMMARY
final-summary.subtitle: Summary
final-summary.winner: Superman holds the edge. Hyperion can still win.
final-summary.line1: Superman sets the terms of the fight more cleanly from the opening seconds.
final-summary.line2: Superman controls the fight better, but Hyperion's regeneration gives him more of an edge with every extra moment the fight lasts.
final-summary.line3: If Superman does not go all out from the start, Hyperion will eventually overwhelm him.

battle-dynamics.headline: BATTLE DYNAMICS
battle-dynamics.subtitle: How the fight changes minute by minute.
battle-dynamics.phase1: Early on, Superman controls the pace through speed and spacing.
battle-dynamics.phase2: If Hyperion survives the first heavy push, he starts gradually making up the difference.
battle-dynamics.phase3: The longer the fight lasts, the more Hyperion's regeneration starts working in his favor.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Superman has the better opening. Hyperion gets more dangerous with every extra minute.

x-factor.headline: X-FACTOR
x-factor.subtitle: The variable that affects the verdict more than ordinary stats.
x-factor.mechanika: Superman has the statistical edge, but Hyperion does not stop under any opponent's pressure.
x-factor.implikacja: If the fight runs in tournament mode instead of to the death, Hyperion's advantage grows with every minute of the fight.
x-factor.psychologia: Hyperion can fight recklessly because mere survival brings him closer to victory.

fight-simulation.headline: FIGHT SIMULATION
fight-simulation.subtitle: The course of the fight across three phases.
fight-simulation.opening: Superman starts with speed, spacing, and cleaner control of the fight.
fight-simulation.midFight: If Hyperion survives the first wave, the fight turns into attrition.
fight-simulation.lateFight: The endgame depends on whether Clark truly closes the fight before Hyperion regains ground through regeneration.
fight-simulation.endCondition: Under standard rules, control carries the edge. In kill-only, simple survival becomes more valuable.

verdict-matrix.headline: VERDICT MATRIX
verdict-matrix.subtitle: Victory depends on the rules.
verdict-matrix.case1: Superman 7/10. Under standard rules and with Solar Flare, he has the clearest path to victory.
verdict-matrix.case2: Superman 5.5/10. Solar Flare gives Superman the win, but a fight to the death still favors Hyperion.
verdict-matrix.case3: Superman 6/10. Without Solar Flare, Superman still has the edge if he can control the fight the whole way and avoid an attrition war with Hyperion.
verdict-matrix.case4: King Hyperion 6/10. Without Solar Flare in a fight to the death, Hyperion's regeneration starts to tilt the odds.
